module: Utility module (loaded by require) that reads and validates the server configuration of the performanceSpatial tracker. Numbers are clamped (NaN/infinity replaced by the default value); all advanced collection options are disabled by default and must be enabled explicitly.
notes: spatialSampleIntervalSeconds: 0 disables sampling, otherwise clamped to 1..3600 s.
levels: at most 64 names (<= 128 characters, [%w_.-]) converted to a lookup table name -> true.

Dip detection thresholds (only if dipTrackingEnabled): dipFpsThreshold 30 (1..360), dipFrameTimeRatio 2 (1.1..10), dipMinDurationMs 250 (50..10000), dipCooldownSeconds 5 (0..3600), maxDipEventsPerSession 100 (1..1000).

read.desc: Returns the normalized configuration: sampleIntervalSeconds, the booleans dipTrackingEnabled, recoveryTrackingEnabled, gameplayExitTrackingEnabled, shaderGenerationTrackingEnabled, sceneComplexityTrackingEnabled, renderTimingTrackingEnabled, optionally levels (lookup table) and detector (dip thresholds).

config.desc: Raw module configuration (a non-table value is treated as {}).
